name: valid-full
description: A config exercising every optional field validates and resolves the named environment.
yaml:
project: Demo
apps:
  - id: main
    platform: android
    appId: com.example.app
    artifact: /builds/app.apk
  - id: alt
    platform: ios
    appId: com.example.alt
environments:
  staging:
    app: main
    device: emulator-5554
    proxy: staging-proxy
    vars:
      apiUrl: https://staging.example.com
  prod:
    app: alt
launch:
  mode: fresh
  clearData: true
preconditions: skip
report:
  formats: [html, json]
  outDir: reports
suites:
  smoke:
    tags: [smoke]
  regression:
    globs: ["tests/regression/**"]
testRoots: [tests]
dataRoots: [fixtures]
